decision: Will a template-page build pay back, and how many of the pages we build will actually earn traffic?
limitations: The default 60% indexation and 30% page-one rates are AAJ assumptions chosen to be sobering, not measured rates. Replace them with your 50-page pilot or Search Console numbers.
The CTR curve predates AI Overviews and the AI Overview drag is an AAJ assumption, so click projections for informational queries are uncertain.
It takes query volume as given. Keyword tools round up long-tail volume, so treat estimates under 50 as directional and pull real volume for a sample of pages.
A good payback does not make the pages safe to build. It takes your unique-data rating on trust and can't see whether pages are linked, crawlable or doorway pages.
review: The SEO or content lead checks the volume sample and the unique-data rating, and the founder confirms conversion rate, value per conversion and build cost. Re-run with observed rates after a 50-page pilot before building the full set.
